facility_name.description: Published facility or participating-unit name; separate branches remain separate records.

phone_numbers.description: Published facility contacts as strings, preserving leading zeros and source spelling; no programme-office footer contacts are substituted.

location.description: Published address and location labels. Contradictory source labels are preserved, not silently geocorrected.

services.description: Published service, procedure, or specialty wording. Broad specialties are not expanded into inferred procedures; empty means not stated in this extract.

validity_dates.description: Published validity periods and qualifications, preserved as source text rather than forced into ISO dates. Blank is unknown, not unlimited validity.

source_links.description: Official source URL(s), with page anchors or public record-search links where available.
